SINDH
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh
Local Government Act, 2013
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 10th April, 2017]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-04/2017, dated
10.4.2017.---The Sindh Local Government
(Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 06th March, 2017 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 03rd April, 2017 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Local Government
Act, 2013, in the manner hereinafter appearing.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 27 of Sindh Act No. XLII of 2013
